title: Chapter 1202
text:
"Alert! Alert! A high energy reaction has occurred in the fourth sector! The specific coordinates are … "

The Fenrir Star System Space Monitoring Station C0075D suddenly sounded an alarm. The staff in the observation room hurriedly gathered in front of the radar screen. They all had the Black Star emblem on their uniforms. They were all army members.

The army had built a large number of space stations in the territory under their jurisdiction to monitor the situation of the entire territory. The artificial intelligence was the main processing, supplemented by a small number of manpower as insurance.

At this moment, a dazzling light dot suddenly lit up on the real-time monitoring star map. The staff hurriedly operated the ultra-long-range astronomical observation device to zoom in. Very soon, the location of the energy explosion was displayed on the screen.

The desolate planet at this location had already disappeared, replaced by a mass of golden energy that was constantly expanding. It was like a star in its later years turning into a red giant. Bright golden lightning arcs surged endlessly like a projected solar prominence.

Seeing this, the staff in the room were puzzled and discussed among themselves.

"What's this phenomenon?"

"It looks like the decay of a star … but there was only a desolate planet here. Where did the star come from?"

"The energy fluctuation is very high. The wave band and frequency are more like the energy of a Beyond Grade A. Could a Beyond Grade A have snuck in?"

Everyone discussed for a while and unanimously decided to follow the instructions of the operation manual and conduct an on-site investigation.

An unmanned spaceship flew out of the space station, accelerated through hyperdrive, and soon arrived at the location of the incident. The golden energy was still expanding, and its volume was extremely large. The unmanned spaceship could not get close at this time and could only patrol by the side to collect data.

This continued for a while. Suddenly, the golden energy stopped expanding and shrank at a speed of hundreds of times, as if it was being continuously devoured. When it shrank to a certain extent, it exploded again, turning into an energy shockwave that spread far away. The observation screen instantly turned white.

The shield of the unmanned spaceship flickered, and its value plummeted. Fortunately, it was relatively far away. Although it suffered some damage, it was not destroyed. The spaceship finally stabilized with great difficulty. The staff in the space station hurriedly looked at the location of the explosion, only to see that the area was already empty. The golden energy cluster had disappeared, and all matter on the desolate planet had been annihilated. Nothing was left.

After looking around, they did not see anyone at all.

"Observation complete. The source of the explosion could not be found. Requesting return."

Hearing the emotionless report of the artificial intelligence, the staff present looked at each other.

"This matter is too strange. It's not something we can handle. Report it to the upper echelons quickly."

…

At the same time, on a barren planet in another system of the army's territory, Han Xiao, who had changed into a new set of King mecha, abruptly appeared on a black wasteland.

"Phew, I was almost caught."

Han Xiao took off his mecha and put away the "Throne" in this place. He exhaled a breath with golden electric arcs.

This time, the advancement had brought about a massive increase in power. He could no longer control the rampaging energy within his body. His cells were producing energy at high efficiency, releasing the energy within his body and accidentally blowing up a planet. In order not to be seen by his subordinates, he had immediately changed into a spare King mecha and ran off the moment his advancement was complete.

He had chosen the location of his advancement in the depths of his own territory in order to keep it a secret. His original strength had already caused the various major forces to fear him. If the outside world were to know that he had made progress in such a short period of time, they would not only fear him, they would be terrified. It might even cause the opposite effect. Therefore, he had chosen to keep a secret, not wanting others to know about it now.

"Master, hum … The Fenrir Star System's command center reported the high energy reaction you triggered. They don't know the cause, so how should I reply, hum?" Philip's childish voice sounded in his mind.

"So fast? Not bad, not bad. Just reply as usual. Send some exploration teams there for a symbolic walk. "

Han Xiao shook his head and smiled.

In the past few years, the Black Star Corps had already established a complete surveillance system in the seven Star Systems of the Garu Star Cluster. He had just left, and the report had already arrived. He was quite satisfied with this reaction speed. It meant that the early warning system in his territory was very effective.

Putting this matter aside, Han Xiao opened the interface again. The notification of the completion of his advancement had already popped up. He rubbed his hands excitedly and opened the interface after his advancement to observe the changes.

Level: 340

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Black Star Race

Attributes: 15914 STR, 15423 DEX, 27010 END, 56460 INT, 13107 MYS, 6,430 CHA, 0 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 135

Awakening Points: 9

Health: 41039094

Stamina: 31662700

Energy: 293475

Lv.25 Energy Bonus Points: + 6,620 STR, + 7,745 DEX, + 10308 END, + 14187 INT, + 6,060 MYS, + 4382600 Stamina Limit, + 9806% Machinery Affinity

Energy Rank: 98510

Grade: SS

Grade S Bonus Points: + 150 END, + 45% All Resistances, + 40% Highest Attribute, + 25% Other Attributes, + 750 Free Attribute Points, + 50 Awakening Points.

The door to a higher level is slowly opening for you …

"Hiss …"

Han Xiao took a deep breath.

The effect of his advancement this time was extremely good! Every attribute had a huge increase. Calculating, every attribute had increased by about one-third compared to before the advancement … except for Luck, which had fallen to 0 when he refreshed it when he created the Universal Treasure. He had forgotten to reset it.

His current attributes were much stronger than when he had just entered the Beyond Grade A realm. This was especially true for his Energy Rank, which had started to increase in the later stages. Every time he reached a higher level, he would receive a stronger increase. The Energy Rank of Lv.25 was about ten times stronger than when he had just entered the Beyond Grade A realm. Indeed, holding one's Energy Rank was the best way for every Beyond Grade A to improve themselves!

The increase in attributes brought by the Race Evolution was about the same as the increase in Energy Rank, which was also huge.

This was especially true for his HP. Not to mention the enemy, even Han Xiao felt like vomiting. At this moment, he had the urge to imitate Wei Yan and shout, "Who can kill me!"

Even if I don't use machinery now, I can still kill a Beyond Grade A Pugilist with less than 52000 Energy Rank with just my body! Furthermore, with my current Intelligence attribute and the various bonuses, the strength of my mechanical army is already extremely terrifying.

Han Xiao clenched his fists, feeling the explosive energy surging in his body, and could not help but smile.

With my current strength, even if I don't use [Virtual Purification-Restore], I shouldn't be afraid of Old Manison bringing out the Felons. As long as his main body dares to appear in front of me, I will dare to capture him and train him. Among the peak Beyond Grade As of this era, probably only [God's Chosen] Wuornos, whose strength I don't know, might be a threat to me.

The higher the Energy Rank, the greater the gap between each point. Han Xiao felt that it was a pity that he did not reach 100,000 Energy Rank this time. After all, this was like a threshold, and he might be able to trigger something.

However, considering that the boundary of Beyond Grade A back then was not a whole number, and there were even decimals, 100,000 Energy Rank might not have any special meaning.

His Grade did not change either. Han Xiao felt that SS was probably the peak of the S Grade, and the next level should be the higher realm that EsGod yearned for. It would be like the gap between a Beyond Grade A and a Calamity Grade.

The Free Attribute Points brought by leveling up from level 331 to level 340 were not used yet. He casually threw some into Luck, making Eggy turn into a stick, and then threw all the remaining Free Attribute Points into Intelligence.

He looked at the cost of leveling up, and the amount skyrocketed again. It was an astronomical figure, and even a rich leek like Han Technician was speechless.

After admiring it for a few more minutes, Han Xiao looked away reluctantly. He thought for a while and pulled down his ability tab.

Previously, he was busy with his Promotion and did not think about the changes of the God's Trait Transformation. This time, Han Xiao fulfilled the five conditions of the God's Trait Transformation and obtained the full five points.

However, [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery] required six points to reach level eleven, and he was still one point short. He wanted to see if the Mission Completion Card would work and reduce the cost.

"Logically speaking, the Mission Completion Card is useful for Promotion missions, and it should also be useful for this kind of leveling condition," Han Xiao mumbled to himself.

He took out the Mission Completion Card, selected the 'Develop Gold Grade Blueprints by myself' requirement, slapped it, and then quickly looked at the notification on the interface.

You have used a Mission Completion Card.

Mission Completion Card has taken effect.

You have completed one of the leveling requirements for [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery]. The leveling cost is reduced by one point.

"Oh, it really works." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

He had obtained quite a number of Random Reward opportunities in the past few years, so he had stocked up on some Mission Completion Cards. If they worked on the God's Trait Transformation, they would have another important use.

"Hmm, although this is good news, I don't know if the leveling requirements will increase in the future. It's better to use them sparingly. I'll try my best to fulfill some of the requirements that I have the ability to fulfill. Anyway, it's just increasing my strength, so there's no harm in doing so," Han Xiao thought to himself.

He still decided to level up [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery] first. If the level limit was still a question mark, he might have invested in the God's Trait Transformation for the Void route. However, now that he realized that the upper limit was not far away, he planned to try and see what changes would happen after he maxed out the God's Trait Transformation route.

At this time, his communicator suddenly rang.

Beep beep beep …

Han Xiao took it out and saw Kasuyi's big face on the screen.

"Black Star, are you done with your business? When are we leaving? "

Han Xiao had once agreed to Kasuyi's request to form a team, but it was delayed because of Modo's matter. After Modo was eliminated, Kasuyi had been sending invitations every now and then. The most recent one was four days ago, when Han Xiao replied that he would wait for a while because of his Promotion. Today, Kasuyi called again and seemed very eager.

"Okay, okay, you came at the right time. I've just finished my business. When do you want to go?" Han Xiao said helplessly.

Only then did Kasuyi smile. "Now."

"So soon?" Han Xiao was surprised.

"That's right. Do you have time?"

"I do, but I don't even know where to go. Don't I have to make any preparations?"

"It's okay. Let's go to the Void Dimension first. I'll tell you the details then."

After saying that, Kasuyi quickly hung up without waiting for Han Xiao to answer.

Han Xiao played with the communicator, becoming more and more curious.

He had only agreed to Kasuyi's invitation as a favor between friends, but he was now more and more interested in the goal of Kasuyi's trip. What could make someone of Kasuyi's level so anxious?

Who knew how long this trip would take? Han Xiao thought about it and sent a message to Sylvia.

"I'm going to the secondary dimension world, and I don't know when I'll be back for the time being. I'll have to let you continue to be in charge for a while."

After waiting for a while, Han Xiao received a reply.

Sylvia: "You might as well not come back."

Han Xiao was helpless.

Hmm … even I know how to strike a balance between work and rest, but Sylvia has to work overtime endlessly. It's normal for her to be a little resentful. I won't argue with a guy whose hairline is in danger.

Han Xiao was about to summon the Mysterious Energy Host to bring him into the secondary dimension world when he suddenly stopped.

"Oh right, I have the Void Authority now, so I should be able to enter and exit the secondary dimension world at will without using the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy."

He closed his eyes and activated this talent, communicating with the Void Dimension.

His consciousness seemed to have sunk into a colorful world. Colorful bubbles flashed across his field of vision. Soon, a large grayish-blue bubble appeared in his line of sight. It grew bigger and bigger.

Han Xiao's heart moved, and according to the instinctive reaction brought by the Void Authority, he inserted his consciousness into the Void Dimension from this very macroscopic perspective.

Puff!

A smooth sound seemed to ring out in his mind. His consciousness entered the Void Dimension without any obstructions. It was as smooth and smooth as lubricant, leaving his mark in the Dimensional Core.

Boom!

The next moment, Han Xiao felt his consciousness spread out, covering the entire Void Dimension. The Void Energy in the dimension seemed to have become an extension of his body, and he could even absorb the energy of the Void Dimension through the connection of his consciousness, like an invisible energy transmission channel.

"So this is what it feels like to connect to a secondary dimension. It's similar to what Hella described …"

Han Xiao was amazed.

There were very few Beyond Grade As who could connect to secondary dimensions. Kasuyi was connected to the Void Dimension, Hella was connected to the Underworld Dimension, and Traveler was connected to the Evil Convergence. Now, he had also entered this category. He had to admit that the endless energy from the secondary dimension nourishing his body was indeed a different feeling.

At this moment, he suddenly thought of something.

"By the way, Kasuyi is also connected to the Void Dimension. I wonder if he will notice …"

…

At the same time, in the Void Dimension …

Kasuyi had just returned to the palace in the Void Dimension from the main universe and was waiting for Black Star to come while absorbing the Void Energy to adjust his state.

Suddenly, his body trembled, and he looked up with a shocked expression.

"Someone connected to the Void Dimension again?"

Kasuyi did not mind others connecting to the Void Dimension because the energy inside was endless, and he did not mind sharing it with another person. After all, he was not a fierce man like Traveler who treated secondary dimensions as his wife.

However, this was not something that could be done overnight. Only void species had such qualifications. They needed to use their mental strength to grind away layers of obstacles before they could touch the core of the dimension and establish a connection. Back then, Kasuyi had tried countless times before he finally connected to the Void Dimension.

However, this unknown newcomer did not have any foreplay and went straight to the core the first time he connected to the dimension. This made it difficult for him to understand.

"Who could this guy be?"

Kasuyi was secretly shocked, and at the same time, he felt a little jealous.

This feeling was like chasing after his sweetheart and only making a little progress after a lot of effort. However, when he turned around, he realized that his sweetheart was not cold to him at all when facing a tall, rich, and handsome guy who appeared out of nowhere. It was not difficult for others to chase after her.

"Even I can't do it so fast. How could this person …"

The more Kasuyi thought about it, the more upset he felt. The Void Energy in his mouth suddenly did not taste good.
